# Secrets Manager UpdateSecret KmsKeyId / BatchGetSecretValue errors, EventBridge target DLQ after a KMS
# refusal, SSE-SQS queue fed by SNS (us-east-1, 2026-11-11). Every resource deleted afterwards.
### Secrets Manager: UpdateSecret with only KmsKeyId
$ aws secretsmanager create-secret --name fc-rec4-56b0342d --secret-string v1
{
    "ARN": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:fc-rec4-56b0342d-YwnA5D",
    "Name": "fc-rec4-56b0342d",
    "VersionId": "4a3dd6c0-7f82-43fa-9b7e-cd2a8ab6b716"
}
[exit 0]
$ aws secretsmanager update-secret --secret-id fc-rec4-56b0342d --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3

An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the UpdateSecret operation: Access to KMS is not allowed
[exit 254]

### EventBridge target DLQ

    "QueueUrl": "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/fc-rec4-dlq-56b0342d"
}
[exit 0]

    "QueueUrl": "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/fc-rec4-target-56b0342d"
}
[exit 0]

### SSE-SQS queue fed by SNS
$ aws sqs create-queue --queue-name fc-rec4-ssesqs-56b0342d --attributes {"Policy": "{\"Version\": \"2012-10-17\", \"Statement\": [{\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": {\"Service\": [\"sns.amazonaws.com\", \"events.amazonaws.com\"]}, \"Action\": \"sqs:SendMessage\", \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-ssesqs-56b0342d\"}]}", "SqsManagedSseEnabled": "true"}
{
    "QueueUrl": "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/fc-rec4-ssesqs-56b0342d"
}
[exit 0]
$ aws sns create-topic --name fc-rec4-topic-56b0342d
{
    "TopicArn": "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-topic-56b0342d"
}
[exit 0]
$ aws sns subscribe --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-topic-56b0342d --protocol sqs --notification-endpoint arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-ssesqs-56b0342d --attributes RawMessageDelivery=true
{
    "SubscriptionArn": "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-topic-56b0342d:66461a5f-7435-42f3-8cec-d7902efc3590"
}
[exit 0]
$ aws sns publish --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-rec4-topic-56b0342d --message to-sse-sqs

    "MessageId": "ebc7bdd5-b2dc-5681-9f8e-debbd615848f"

[exit 0]
